A little hard to please.

The friend who says “we’re only looking”… then notices the clasp on your pouch.

A heart, a clasp, a photograph.

Kariann starts with a small detail that makes you look. Then we ask where the object belongs: getting ready to meet friends, finding your little things or keeping photos from a day out. This edit brings together fifteen products from Japanese and Korean brands.

The friend behind the name

An eye for detail and a weakness for lovely small objects. The Kariann mood: a little hard to please, but easily won over when good looks meet a useful idea.

Why these fifteen?

Portable formats, prices from €4.45 to €38 and details you can see: a sliding lid, coloured mesh, an iridescent cover. Each page explains the choice and its small catch. The edit is based on published features and editorial judgment, without paid rankings.

Where to buy

Prices were checked on 13 September 2026, excluding delivery. Links lead to MiiN Cosmetics, Mark’Style Tokyo, Atelier Kumo, Moments or La Japeterie. MiiN is a European retailer with shops in France; online dispatch country is not confirmed. The other selected retailers are French shops. For another EU country, check delivery areas, returns and the complete total on the retailer’s website. We do not guarantee live stock or delivery throughout the EU.

Choices, not invented results

We do not assign ratings or claim tests of wear, effectiveness or popularity. Check cosmetics against the photographs of the specific shade; colour varies with light and skin tone. Brand origin does not automatically indicate the manufacturing country.

Images, sources and links

Product photographs are credited to retailers on each detail page. Being online does not establish commercial reuse or AI-editing rights; those permissions still need checking before commercial distribution. Sources used for the text and translations are listed on each product page. No commission-earning links or brand partnerships are active in this edition.

What about the older guides?

They remain available in previous editions, with their research dates and sources. Their prices and stock are not presented as refreshed with this new selection.
